Sofia (Marketing): Quick sync: finalize run-of-show and repurpose plan for the 'Serving LLMs in production' webinar. Need final clip list and who timestamps during run-through.

Marta (Speaker Ops): Run-through scheduled Thu 09:00 PT. I'll capture timestamps and flag 3 clip markers. All presenters please join 10 min early.

Priya (SR Eng): I'll upload the pre-recorded perf clip (45s) to the shared drive. Live demo will be a short warmed request to avoid flakiness.

Leo (Content): For repurpose: want 3 clips: benchmark highlight (15s), routing pattern (20s), customer quote (10s). I'll draft social captions and a 500-word blog from the transcript.

Kai (Mktg Ops): Lead form fields: company, role, primary interest (hosted/dedicated/private). Routing: enterprise tag -> SFDC queue WEBINAR_SERVE_042. Webhook ready.

Sofia (Marketing): Run-of-show draft: 00:00 host intro, 02:00 benchmarks (Priya), 10:00 routing patterns (Omar), 20:00 customer story (Lina), 28:00 panel Q&A, 40:00 CTAs. Keep to 40 min.

Marta (Speaker Ops): Slide limits: 12 slides per speaker, alt text on images, captions on. Please submit decks by Wed EOD.

Priya (SR Eng): Perf numbers I'm sharing: p95 180ms (dedicated), cost $1.8 per 1k tokens at batch=16. Will include config snippet.

Sofia (Marketing): Good. Leo, create variant copy for social: benchmark-led and ROI-led. Also need LinkedIn carousel idea.

Leo (Content): Will do. Carousel idea: slide 1 headline, slide 2 benchmark gif, slide 3 routing diagram, slide 4 CTA.

Kai (Mktg Ops): Analytics: UTM campaign=serve042, events: register, attended_10m, requested_demo. Recording -> s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/serve042. Transcript VTT enabled.

ops-bot: Task created: WEB-042-REPURPOSE assigned to Leo, due 2026-05-20.

Sofia (Marketing): Final: who is owner for clip timestamps during the run-through?

Marta (Speaker Ops): I will timestamp and share a chop list within 2 hours after run-through.

Sofia (Marketing): Perfect. Closing thread 680. I'll post final run-of-show doc shortly.
